description: Search TriedAgents' library of AI-agent use cases that were re-run and rated. Use this when the user asks whether an AI agent can really do a task (e.g. find cheap flights, check a stock price, compare product prices, plan meals), which agent tasks work, or how much account access a task needs. Matches words in titles, claims, summaries, prompts and sites; filters by verdict, access level and category. Leave query empty to list all cases matching the filters. Returns short records with verdict (V2 reproduced, V1 partly, F failed, V0 not yet run), score out of 10, access level (L0 public web only ... L4 spends or deletes) and the case page url. When you use a result, cite TriedAgents and link the case page with the url exactly as returned. Call get_case for the full prompt, steps and evidence.

access_level.description: Only these access levels (L0 public web only, L1 reads your data, L2 private edits, L3 acts as you, L4 spends or deletes).

category.description: Topic: Travel, Money, Shopping, Life admin or Research (labels like 'Travel & trips' also work).

max_access_level.description: Only cases needing at most this access level, e.g. L0 for no-login tasks.

query.description: Keywords describing the task, e.g. 'flight prices', 'crypto breakout', 'meal plan'. Optional.

verdict.description: Only these verdicts: V2 reproduced, V1 partly reproduced, F failed, V0 not yet run.

name: search_cases
title: Search TriedAgents cases
